design_notes:
Method: sunlit generation from area, efficiency, and pointing. Scale by the array's relative output at the design life, then by the sunlit fraction. Margin is generation over load, minus one.
Valid range: design life inside the degradation measures. Ratios must lie between 0 and 1.
What varies per spacecraft: array area, cell choice, pointing, orbit sunlight, load, and life.
Assumption: one pointing factor stands for the whole orbit. A tumbling or sun-tracking spacecraft needs its own value.
Revision: the PowerBus decomposition added a conditioning unit and a harness. Delivered power is generation times conversion efficiency times one minus the harness loss fraction. Margin uses delivered power. Both default to lossless, so the worked cases, which predate the bus breakdown, still hold.

terms.name: pointing_factor
terms.description: Average cosine of the sun angle on the array

terms.name: sunlit_fraction
terms.description: Fraction of the orbit in sunlight

terms.name: generation_avg_w
terms.description: Orbit-average generation at end of life

terms.name: relative_output
terms.description: Array output at end of life relative to beginning of life

terms.name: passes
terms.description: True when the design meets the requirement

terms.name: conversion_efficiency
terms.description: Efficiency of the power conditioning unit between array and load

terms.name: harness_loss_fraction
terms.description: Fraction of conditioned power lost in the harness

terms.name: delivered_avg_w
terms.description: Orbit-average power delivered to the load after bus losses
